title: Istio header-conditioned route over a shared prefix (preserve or refuse, never drop the condition)
claims: a request carrying x-acceptance-variant: beta reaches the header-gated backend
the same path without the header reaches the fallback backend
not_claimed: regex/prefix header matchers, query matchers, sourceLabels
not_established: Istio full mesh behavior; ingress projection only
source_semantics: Istio evaluates http[] in order; the first entry matches only with the header. Dropping the header condition would send every request to the gated backend, so the converter must preserve it (e.g. ordered dispatch) or refuse both overlapping routes with a report error.
